about_the_game:
Several years have passed in a blink of an eye since the interstellar escape. I haven't been able to sleep lately, there's always a shadow swaying in front of me. Does it not look like a human? These shadows swayed back and forth, finally stopping on the wall, motionless, suddenly turning into puppets and zombies, rushing towards me! I woke up and saw a psychedelic interstellar space unfolding in front of me .....

“Interstellar Spirit "is a psychedelic style multiplayer horror cooperative game, including single player simple and difficult versions, as well as multiplayer cooperative versions.

Players need to complete the collection tasks displayed on each level screen within a unlimited or limited time. After completing the tasks, a painting export will appear for players to find and upgrade to the next level through the export. In the collection task, players will encounter attacks from puppet guardians or zombie guardians in the level. At the last minute in difficult level, zombies will accelerate their speed. Players can (but not necessarily) search for weapons from interstellar space and kill them. If the player is killed by the Guardian or the time limit has expired, the game will return to the beginning and the player will challenge the Interstellar Holy Spirit again.

Game button: E-obtain weapons, collect tasks, and put them into the recycling cardboard box; F-switch flashlight; Left mouse button - kill puppets or zombies; AWSD - Move forward, backward, left, and right; Mouse movement - controls character rotation."
